description: This file implements a SocketConnectionFactory class that provides methods to create and manage TCP socket connections asynchronously, including setting socket options and handling connection errors. It also defines a custom exception class for socket connection errors.

classes.name: SocketConnectionFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating TCP socket connections with configurable options, including connection establishment and error handling.

classes.name: SocketConnectionFactory.SingleUseSocketAsyncEventArgs
classes.description: A sealed subclass of SocketAsyncEventArgs that provides a Task-based completion source for asynchronous socket connection operations.

classes.name: SocketConnectionException
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating socket connection errors, serializable and derived from OrleansException.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously establishes a TCP connection to the specified endpoint, configuring socket options and handling connection success or failure.

methods.name: OnCompleted
methods.description: Callback invoked when the socket async operation completes, setting the task completion source result.

methods.name: SocketConnectionException (constructors)
methods.description: Constructors for creating a socket connection exception, including serialization support.
